Over the years, similar antics have followed the Globetrotters around the world, including to 123 countries and territories and all six continents on which basketballs grow naturally. That's where Playworks comes in. Serving 54,000 Arizona students, the non-profit helps communities by reinventing the concept and execution of recess at neighborhood schools. Their method begins with sending fully trained coaches primarily to low-income, Title-1 schools all over the Valley. Once there, the coaches turn recess times into more positive experiences by leading organized, supervised games and activities that allow all students to participate. If you're excited to see The Nutcracker this holiday season, head over here to get tickets to the Ahwatukee Foothill's Ballet December 17th or 18th for as low as $10.40 with code SAVE20 (20% off). I heard that Santa himself will make an appearance at both 2 PM shows!
"Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. Sneaking downstairs to see the toy after everyone else has gone to bed, she suddenly finds herself caught in the middle of a pitched battle between the toys and an army of mice. After saving the nutcracker with a well-thrown shoe to the Mouse King’s head, Clara and her now-living prince venture into the Land of Snow and the Land of Sweets to celebrate.
Throughout their adventures, Tchaikovsky’s dazzling inventiveness propels the dances of nimble flowers and regal fairy queens. The “Waltz of the Snowflakes” floats weightlessly above the angelic voices of a youth choir, whereas the “Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy” tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. A medley of exotic national dances—including a Spanish bolero and Russian Trepak—add to the phantasmagoric celebration before the whole dream ends, as all dreams must.
Company Website
Contact Dance Studio 111 at (480) 706-6040 for questions or hours. Must pick-up tickets at Dance Studio 111. Office hours are Mon.–Thurs. 3–7:30pm, Fridays 3–6:30pm, Sat. 9am–2pm. Closed Sundays."

"In 1984, Space Biospheres Ventures purchased a few unassuming acres north of Tucson in the shadow the Santa Catalina Mountains. There, the company expanded its sci-fi-sounding activities—the development of space-colonization technology—and built what would evolve into Biosphere 2.
Designed to re-create Earth's ecosystems, the gigantic glass enclosure (some 7.2 million cubic feet and 91 feet tall in some parts) is famous for housing biospherians in the 1990s. The researchers lived completely sealed inside for extended periods, giving scientists groundbreaking data on human survivability and interaction with particular bionetworks.
The University of Arizona had the 40-acre Biosphere 2 campus donated in 2011, maintaining it as a hub of serious research while expanding its mission to encompass interactive educational outreach. Each year, thousands pass through the on-site labs and classrooms as well as stroll the Biosphere 2 interior to view films, experience multimedia exhibits, or embark on guided tours. Tours venture into the actual ecosystems, allowing earthlings to note biodiversity, smell fresh precipitation in the rain forest, and savor the softness of savannah grassland underfoot until the resident grumpy old man yells at you to get the heck off his lawn. Before their dramatic conclusion at a million-gallon ocean tank, tours delve into the basement to explore the technosphere, where visitors can witness the deep inhales and exhales of the sphere’s respiratory system."
Enjoy!

posts.text:
If you know someone who is in need of a dentist and might not have dental insurance, I hope you'll share this deal with them! Head over here for more information about the GRAND OPENING of the new OnCall Dental urgent care Saturday, October 18th from 10AM-2PM. I was worried about huge wait times. They told me that they weren't expecting long waits but if there happened to be huge wait times, they would honor the free service and schedule individuals on a different day!
Here's a little bit more information about the place:
About OnCall Dental Urgent Care
"OnCall Dental Urgent Care treat all patients, not just emergencies. People working regular 9-5 day shifts with little schedule flexibility will now have somewhere to go to receive quality regular and emergency dental care during evenings and on weekends. Our goal is to help the medical community by treating their patients with dental emergencies. Emergency rooms, medical urgent care facilities and family practice offices are being flooded with dental emergencies. All they can do is write a prescription for pain medication, antibiotics and refer the patient to their dentist. These dental emergency visits are costing hospitals millions of dollars every year and all they can give is a temporary solution. Now those same patients can be referred to OnCall where they can be seen the same day for extractions, root canals or whatever treatment is needed."
SHARE SHARE SHARE!

posts.title: It's First Friday! FREE Admission to the Children's Museum of Phoenix, The Heard Museum, The Phoenix Art Museum, and More!
posts.excerpt: Hooray! Today (10/3) is First Friday! If you don't have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an…
posts.text:
Hooray! Today (10/3) is First Friday! If you don't have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an Ollie the Trolley ride, and some FREE museums! Anyone that says Phoenix has no culture has obviously never been to First Friday!
Head to the Children's Museum of Phoenix where everyone will get in free from 5-9 PM. Tickets are usually $11 each, so this is quite an opportunity to play for less!
Visit the Heard Museum for their First Friday Native + You program. Everyone will get into the museum FOR FREE from 6-10 (tickets are usually $18 for adults, $7.50 for kids), and there will be music, breakdancing, lowriders, and more!
Still have energy? Go to the Phoenix Art Museum for their First Friday event. Everyone will get in for free from 6-10 PM (tickets are usually $15 for adults, $6 for kids).
If it's date night and you're leaving the kids at home, head to Adults Night Out at the Arizona Science Center. Adults will get in free from 5:30-9 (tickets are usually $16.95) AND they'll have an open bar and lots of fun!
Just to recap, if you take your family of four (two adults, two kids) to the Children's Museum of Phoenix, the Heard Museum, and the Phoenix Art Museum, you'll save a whopping $137 on admission (more if you have more kids).
If it's date night, I'm assuming you won't head to the Children's Museum, but you and your date will save $99.90 on tickets to the Arizona Science Center, the Heard, and the Phoenix Art Museum. AND you're sure to have a great time! The weather couldn't be any more beautiful!
Enjoy!

posts.title: As Seen on Good Morning Arizona...Shopping Tips at Safeway!
posts.excerpt: Thanks so much for tuning into Good Morning Arizona today where I'm sharing my shopping tips at all of the stores all week long. I hope you'll "like" Alicia's…
posts.text:
Thanks so much for tuning into Good Morning Arizona today where I'm sharing my shopping tips at all of the stores all week long. I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook where I'll help you "live life better for less" every single day. In case you missed Monday's Walmart segment you can check it out here.
Video
Today we're talking Safeway. Be sure to download the Just for U app to your phone via iTunes or Google Play (or log-in on your computer). The app ties directly to your Safeway Club Card and gives you discounts based on what you buy on a regular basis. So even if an item isn't on sale, it very well may be on sale for you. The savings are significant! On my app I had free Pillsbury cookies to add to my card, a gallon of milk for $1.99, a veggie tray for $4.50, and lots of other great deals that tie in with my shopping habits. You'll save around 20% (I've saved more than that at times) and you can add the deals while you're shopping (no planning ahead). It actually makes grocery shopping more fun.
Another app you won't want to miss is ibotta. Head over here to download it to your phone. This app allows you to save even more on things you’re already buying (on top of any sales or coupons or Just for U deals). It works at Safeway, Costco,Walmart, Target, Fry's, Walgreens, CVS, Dollar General, Sam's Club, Whole Foods, Sprouts, PetSmart, even AMC movie theaters. You add products to your app and learn about them. When you buy them, you take a picture of your receipt, and you'll get the rebate amount directly into your ibotta account. You can cash out once you hit at least $5 and send the money directly to your Paypal account or get Starbucks or iTunes gift cards. Examples of ibotta rebates at Safeway (each store has a list):
Earn $.50 when you buy a gallon of white milk (any brand) and take a poll and take a survey (takes seconds).
Earn $1.00 when you buy O Organics salad, learn a face, how to, and post on facebook
Earn $1.25 when you buy Banana Boat sunscreen, play trivia, and post on facebook
There are 88 possible rebates at Safeway and if there are items on your list, you can get back a bunch every shopping trip wherever you shop! Be sure to download the app!
Another tip to keep in mind when you shop is that ALL MANUFACTURERS' COUPONS are worth at least $1 at Safeway. You don't need to get the paper to enjoy the savings, you can head over here to find a huge assortment of printable coupons. You only print the coupons you'll use!
When you match coupons to sales, you'll do well. For example, Honey Nut Cheerios are on sale for $1.88 a box through Tuesday, May 13th. Use this coupon for $.50 off a box of Honey Nut Cheerios, it'll be worth $1. That means an $.88 box of Honey Nut Cheerios! It's pretty hard to beat that price.
Safeway also has fuel points. You can earn up to $1 off per gallon at Safeway, Chevron, and Texaco stations. Head over here for more details.
If you keep these tips in mind when you shop Safeway, you'll save a bunch! Enjoy!
